en.html:
Ichijou"Then... Minato sir, why did you—"
Kageaki"First reason. For our purpose, a disturbance is unhelpful. In fact, we can no longer investigate that area."
Ichijou"...Yes. Sorry..."
Kageaki"No apology needed. Second reason. If the argument continued, violence seemed unavoidable. I bowed and ended it."
Ichijou"But a fellow like that! You could easily—"
Kageaki"Knock him down, stamp on his head, force him to apologize and promise not to do it again?"
Ichijou"...Er, well..."
Ichijou"Yes..."
Kageaki"Perhaps. Perhaps that would even be right."
Kageaki"But I do not want to."
Ichijou"...Why?"
Kageaki"I just said it. Violence against the weak is contemptible."
Ichijou"............"
Kageaki"That man appeared to be a civilian. Probably no way of defeating someone trained in combat."
Kageaki"For whatever reason, if I inflict one-sided violence on such a man... I will despise myself."
